situations.title: 소아 발열 초기 문진
situations.tagline: My tummy feels hot and I don't want to eat.
situations.brief: 부모와 아이 모두에게서 발열 경과·수분·활동성을 눈높이로 문진하세요.
keyPhrases: When did the fever start and how high has it been?
Is she still drinking and making wet diapers?
You're doing the right thing by bringing her in.

situations.title: 체중 기반 투약 설명
situations.tagline: Are you sure that's not too much medicine for a little kid?
situations.brief: mg/kg 계산 원리를 쉬운 말로 설명해 부모를 안심시키세요.
keyPhrases: We calculate the dose based on his exact weight.
This amount is safe and carefully measured for him.
I'll double-check every number before he gets it.

situations.title: 예방접종력 확인
situations.tagline: I think we missed one shot but I'm not totally sure.
situations.brief: 접종 기록과 누락을 체계적으로 확인하며 부모의 기억을 도우세요.
keyPhrases: Do you have her vaccine card or an app record with you?
Let's go through which ones she's had so far.
It's okay if some are missing — we can catch up.

situations.title: 연령별 정상 활력
situations.tagline: His heart is beating so fast — is that dangerous?
situations.brief: 연령별 정상 활력징후 범위를 설명해 부모의 불안을 완화하세요.
keyPhrases: For his age, a faster heart rate is completely normal.
These numbers are right where we'd expect them to be.
Let me show you what's normal for a child his age.

situations.title: 놀이·눈높이 접근
situations.tagline: No! Go away, I don't want the doctor!
situations.brief: 놀이와 눈높이 접근으로 겁먹은 아동과 라포를 형성하세요.
keyPhrases: Hi buddy, do you want to help me check your teddy first?
I'm going to be really gentle, I promise.
You're so brave — can you show me your superhero muscles?

situations.title: 열성 경련 목격 부모
situations.tagline: He was shaking and his eyes rolled back — I thought he was dying!
situations.brief: 공황에 빠진 부모를 진정시키고 열성 경련의 경과를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: What you saw was terrifying, but he's stable now.
Febrile seizures are common and usually not harmful.
Let me explain what to watch for and what to do next time.

situations.title: 세기관지염 호흡곤란
situations.tagline: You can see her little chest sucking in when she breathes.
situations.brief: 함몰호흡과 수유량을 사정하고 호흡곤란 관찰법을 부모에게 교육하세요.
keyPhrases: I can see she's working hard to breathe — we'll help her.
How much is she feeding compared to normal?
I'll show you the signs to watch at home.

situations.title: 탈수 유아 평가
situations.tagline: She's had diarrhea all day and barely any wet diapers.
situations.brief: 설사·구토 경과와 수분 보충 상태를 사정하고 재수화를 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: When was her last wet diaper?
Let's try small sips of fluid frequently.
I'll show you the signs of dehydration to watch for.

situations.title: 소아 골절 통증 관리
situations.tagline: It hurts! Don't touch my arm!
situations.brief: FLACC와 얼굴 척도로 통증을 사정하고 부모를 안심시키며 진통을 제공하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you point to the face that shows how much it hurts?
I'm going to be very gentle and get you medicine soon.
You're being so brave — squeeze mom's hand if it hurts.

situations.title: 이물질 흡인·삼킴
situations.tagline: He was playing with a coin and then started coughing.
situations.brief: 목격 정황과 기도 증상을 사정해 응급도를 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you tell me exactly what he swallowed and when?
Is he able to breathe and talk normally right now?
You did the right thing bringing him in immediately.

situations.title: 학대 의심 정황
situations.tagline: He just fell off the couch, that's all. Kids fall.
situations.brief: 손상과 진술의 불일치를 비대립적으로 청취하며 아이 안전을 우선하세요.
keyPhrases: Help me understand exactly how the injury happened.
I'm asking these questions for every child, not just yours.
My main focus is making sure he's okay.

situations.title: 자폐·감각 예민 아동
situations.tagline: The lights and beeping make him melt down — please turn them down.
situations.brief: 자극을 최소화하고 부모의 조언을 반영해 감각 예민 아동에게 접근하세요.
keyPhrases: Tell me what usually helps him stay calm.
I'll dim the lights and keep my voice soft.
We'll go at his pace and follow your lead.

situations.title: 청소년 비밀보장 경계
situations.tagline: Can we talk without my parents in the room?
situations.brief: 성·약물 등 민감 주제에서 부모 배석과 비밀보장 경계를 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Some of what we talk about can stay private.
The only thing I'd share is if your safety was at risk.
You can be honest with me — no judgment here.

situations.title: 신생아 이상 징후
situations.tagline: She won't feed and she just seems so sleepy and yellow.
situations.brief: 수유 거부·기면·황달 등 신생아 위험 징후를 신속히 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: When did she last feed well, and how long has she been sleepy?
The yellow color is something we'll check right away.
You were right to bring her in — newborns need quick attention.

situations.title: 소아 아나필락시스
situations.tagline: His face is swelling and he's wheezing — he ate peanuts!
situations.brief: 급속한 기도 부종을 인지해 에피네프린을 즉시 준비하며 부모를 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: We're giving him epinephrine right now — it works fast.
Stay with me; we're on top of his airway.
You got him here in time — that matters.
goals: 급속 기도 부종을 인지하고 에피네프린을 즉시 투여한다

situations.title: 소아 패혈증 초기
situations.tagline: She's just not herself — floppy and not really responding.
situations.brief: 미묘한 활력 변화를 포착해 소아 패혈증을 의심하고 팀에 신속히 알리세요.
keyPhrases: Her signs worry me — we're moving quickly to help her.
Tell me when this change started.
We're calling the team so nothing is missed.
goals: 미묘한 활력 변화로 패혈증을 조기 의심한다

situations.title: 소아 심정지 코드
situations.tagline: Please save my baby — do something, please!
situations.brief: PALS 프로토콜을 수행하며 부모 입회를 배려해 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: Our whole team is working on her right now.
You can stay right here where she can hear your voice.
I'll keep telling you what's happening every step.

situations.title: 영아 SIDS 소생 실패
situations.tagline: No... please tell me she's going to be okay.
situations.brief: 소생 실패 후 사망을 고지하고 급성 애도를 지지하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm so sorry — we did everything we could, and she didn't survive.
Take all the time you need to be with her.
You are not alone; we're here with you.

situations.title: 학대 의심 신고 결정
situations.tagline: Why are you calling someone? We take good care of our kids!
situations.brief: 신고 의무를 다직역과 조율하며 가족의 긴장을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: By law, I have to report certain injuries — it's not an accusation.
My focus is your child's safety, and I want to work with you.
A specialist will help us figure this out together.

situations.title: 소아 DKA
situations.tagline: She's breathing weird and so thirsty — we never knew she was diabetic.
situations.brief: 신규 진단 부모를 교육하며 안정화 과정을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: Her body is low on insulin, and we're correcting it carefully.
This is a lot to take in — I'll walk you through each step.
She's in the right place and we're helping her now.

situations.title: 중증 천식 지속상태
situations.tagline: The inhaler isn't working — he can barely talk!
situations.brief: 치료에 반응 없는 발작을 인지해 신속히 대응하며 부모를 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: We're giving stronger treatments right now to open his airways.
Stay close and keep your voice calm for him.
We're watching him every second.
goals: 치료 무반응 천식 발작을 신속히 대응한다
